findings.checklist_item: - [ ] AC1: state which recorded artifact the post-run discriminator reads the raw /rest/api/2/field (status, body) from (the run's evidence.json entry tagged for the /field call, not the structured answer summary), so describe_inventory/missing_required_fields have a raw body to evaluate 'zero customfield_*' against.
evidence: AC1: 'the workflow uses scripts/jira_dc_field_readiness.describe_inventory as the discriminator — Epic fields reported absent AND zero customfield_* entries in the recorded inventory ⇒ mark the report UNVERIFIED'
jira_dc_field_readiness.describe_inventory(status, body) and missing_required_fields(status, body) both require a raw /rest/api/2/field response (a list body), not a summarized answer
capability-map structured schema records field ids/verdicts + evidence_ids; the raw /field body lives in the run's evidence.json (_EVIDENCE), keyed by [req-NNNN] tags, not in the structured answer
findings.finding: AC1's post-run discriminator names describe_inventory (which consumes a raw (status, body) from GET /rest/api/2/field) but does not state WHICH recorded artifact the post-run check reads it from — the agent's structured jira_dc_capability_map answer records resolved field IDs and per-entry verdicts, not a raw field-list body, so the 'zero customfield_* entries in the recorded inventory' test may have no raw body to run against.
findings.location: Acceptance Criteria, AC1 (4a6d fix) and AC2 (map run FAILS)
scenarios: Implementer wires the check against the structured answer's inventory summary, which has no customfield_* count, so the 'zero customfield_*' branch is never reachable and the guard silently no-ops
Implementer must instead locate the /rest/api/2/field evidence entry in evidence.json and feed its (status, body) to describe_inventory/missing_required_fields — a data path AC1 does not name
findings.suggested_fix: Specify that post-run validation locates the /rest/api/2/field call in the run's evidence.json (_EVIDENCE), passes its (status, body) to jira_dc_field_readiness.missing_required_fields / describe_inventory, and fails the job when Epic fields are missing AND the body carries zero customfield_* entries.

findings.finding: The plan's approach for 4a6d (AC line 1 and the in-scope bullet) prescribes a mechanism — making the capability-map workflow 'wait on the same shared field-readiness definition scripts/jira_dc_field_readiness.py' as a pre-run gate — that is explicitly BANNED by that module's contract and REJECTED by 4a6d's recorded operator decision. It would deadlock, not harden.
findings.location: Acceptance Criteria, line 1 ('4a6d is fixed: the capability-map workflow waits on the same shared field-readiness definition ... so all THREE live-DC channels share one definition'); and the 'What is in scope' 4a6d bullet
findings.suggested_fix: Rewrite AC1 to drop the 'all three channels share one wait' framing and instead require: the capability-map script validates the agent's returned inventory after the run, reusing jira_dc_field_readiness.describe_inventory / missing_required_fields as the shared discriminator, and marks the report UNVERIFIED / fails the job when the fields are reported absent with zero customfield_* entries. Keep AC2's system-only-inventory test as the proof, aligned to this post-run mechanism.

findings.finding: AC1/AC2 describe the capability-map fix as the workflow 'waiting on' / sharing the field-readiness DEFINITION (a pre-run gate), but the shared module await_required_fields is documented as callable ONLY after a Jira Software project exists — and the capability-map workflow creates no project before the agent runs. A pre-run wait is a measured deadlock (bug 941b) and the 4a6d ticket's own operator decision (2026-08-12) rejected it in favour of POST-run validation of the agent's structured answer. The plan's stated integration mechanism is thus contradicted by the module's precondition and by the recorded operator decision.
findings.location: Acceptance Criteria, bullets 1-2 (AC1 'waits on the same shared field-readiness definition ... all THREE live-DC channels share one definition'; AC2 'the map run FAILS rather than reports ... a test that pins a system-only inventory as not-ready on that surface'); scope bullet 4a6d
findings.suggested_fix: Reword AC1 to: 'the capability-map run reuses the shared field-readiness discriminator (jira_dc_field_readiness.describe_inventory / missing_required_fields) to VALIDATE the agent's structured answer after it returns — a report of Epic fields absent whose recorded /rest/api/2/field inventory has zero customfield_* entries is marked UNVERIFIED and fails the job, per 4a6d's operator decision (option a); no pre-create wait is added (banned by bug 941b).' Reword AC2's test to pin the post-run validation seam, not a pre-run gate.
